name: cms.scss
html:
<pre class="docs-code"><code class="lang-scss">// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  cms.scss — the whole CMS/admin theme + component styles (dark developer
//  console aesthetic: panels, forms, lists, toasts, login). Loaded only by
//  the CMS bundle — never by the public site.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../core/sass/base/variables';

// ── Token Publication ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
// The public site publishes its design tokens on :root via _structure.scss.
// The CMS document never loads that file — without this block every
// var(--radius-*), var(--font-primary) and var(--text-primary) inside a
// component's shadow DOM resolves to nothing (serif fallback + black text on
// dark panels). Custom properties set on :host inherit into the shadow tree;
// :root additionally covers the document when this sheet is linked page-wide.
:host,
:root {
  --font-primary: 'Raleway', sans-serif;
  --text-primary: #{$cms-text-primary};

  --skel-bg-1: #{$cms-bg-card};
  --skel-bg-2: #{$cms-bg-dark};

  --radius-none: 0;
  --radius-hairline: #{to-rem($space-hairline)};
  --radius-2xs: #{to-rem($space-2xs)};
  --radius-xs: #{to-rem($space-xs)};
  --radius-sm: #{to-rem($space-sm)};
  --radius-md: #{to-rem($space-md)};
  --radius-lg: #{to-rem($space-lg)};
  --radius-xl: #{to-rem($space-xl)};
  --radius-full: 50%;
  --radius-round: 9999px;

  --z-top: #{$z-top};
}

// ── Document base ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Applies only where the compiled sheet is linked at page level
// (cms/index.html); shadow-DOM copies ignore it harmlessly.
html {
  background-color: $cms-bg-darkest;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background-color: $cms-bg-darkest;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
  font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

#cms {
  min-height: 100vh;
}

// ── CMS & Admin Theme System ─────────────────────────────────────────

// Shared box-sizing reset for the CMS shell + login screen.
.cms-container,

// Centered login layout.
.admin-login-wrapper {
  box-sizing: border-box;

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
}

// CMS page shell — full-height dark console background.
.cms-container {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background-color: $cms-bg-darkest;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
  font-family:
    'Raleway',
    system-ui,
    -apple-system,
    sans-serif;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

// ── Admin Login Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
.admin-login-wrapper {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, $cms-bg-dark 0%, $cms-bg-darkest 70%);
  padding: 2rem;
}

// The login card panel.
.admin-login-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: $cms-card-max-width;
  background: rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.65);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 3rem 2.5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  text-align: center;

  .admin-title {
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: $color-white;
  }

  .admin-subtitle {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: $cms-text-subtle;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }

  .google-auth-btn {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-lg);
    background: $color-white;
    color: $color-black;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;

    &:hover {
      background: $color-grey-2;
      transform: translateY(-#{to-rem($space-2xs)});
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    }

    &:disabled {
      opacity: 0.6;
      cursor: not-allowed;
      transform: none;
    }

    .google-icon {
      width: to-rem($space-xl);
      height: to-rem($space-xl);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
  }

  .admin-error-msg {
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    background: rgba(255, 75, 75, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 75, 75, 0.3);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    color: $cms-error;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
  }
}

// ── CMS Header & Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-header {
  min-height: $cms-header-min-height;
  background: rgba(15, 20, 28, 0.9);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1rem 2rem;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;

  .cms-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-lg);
    cursor: pointer;

    .cms-logo {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: to-rem($space-2xs);
      color: $cms-accent;
    }

    .cms-badge {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-md);
      background: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.15);
      color: $cms-accent;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      letter-spacing: to-rem($space-hairline);
    }
  }

  // ── Quick Cloud & AI Admin Bar ─────────────────────────────────────
  .cms-quick-tools {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin: 0.4rem 0;

    .cms-dropdown {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-block;

      &:hover .cms-dropdown-menu,
      &:focus-within .cms-dropdown-menu {
        opacity: 1;
        visibility: visible;
        transform: translateY(0);
        pointer-events: auto;
      }
    }

    .cms-quick-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: to-rem($space-sm);
      background: rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.7);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      color: $cms-text-primary;
      padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;

      .cms-btn-icon {
        font-size: 0.95rem;
      }

      .cms-caret {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        color: $cms-text-subtle;
        transition: transform 0.2s ease;
      }

      &:hover {
        background: rgba(45, 58, 74, 0.9);
        border-color: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.4);
        color: $color-white;

        .cms-caret {
          color: $cms-accent;
          transform: rotate(180deg);
        }
      }

      &--ai {
        background: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.12);
        border-color: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.35);
        color: $cms-accent;

        &:hover {
          background: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.22);
          box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.25);
        }
      }

      &--bucket {
        &:hover {
          border-color: $cms-badge-warn;
        }
      }

      &--firebase {
        &:hover {
          border-color: $cms-badge-amber;
        }
      }

      &--billing {
        &:hover {
          border-color: $cms-badge-green;
        }
      }
    }

    .cms-dropdown-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      left: 0;
      min-width: $cms-dropdown-min-width;
      background: $cms-bg-card;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 0.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
      z-index: 1000;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: to-rem($space-xs);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(to-rem($space-xs));
      transition:
        opacity 0.15s ease,
        transform 0.15s ease,
        visibility 0.15s ease;
      pointer-events: none;

      &::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        top: -#{to-rem($space-md)};
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        height: to-rem($space-md);
      }

      .cms-dropdown-item {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: to-rem($space-md);
        padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
        color: $cms-text-primary;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
        transition: all 0.15s ease;
        cursor: pointer;

        .item-icon {
          font-size: 1rem;
        }

        &:hover {
          background: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.15);
          color: $cms-accent;
          transform: translateX(to-rem($space-xs));
        }
      }
    }
  }

  .cms-user-info {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;

    .cms-avatar {
      width: to-rem($space-2xl);
      height: to-rem($space-2xl);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .cms-email {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: $cms-text-muted;
    }

    .cms-logout-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      color: $color-white;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.2s;

      &:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      }
    }
  }
}

// ── CMS Tabs & Sub-header ─────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-nav-tabs {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1.5rem 2rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

  .cms-tab-btn {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    color: $cms-text-subtle;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;

    &:hover {
      color: $color-white;
    }

    &.active {
      color: $cms-accent;
      border-bottom-color: $cms-accent;
    }
  }
}

// Tab content area.
.cms-main-content {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 2rem;
  max-width: $cms-container-max-width;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

// ── CMS Cards & Form Controls ─────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-card {
  background: rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.4);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;

  .cms-card-title {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    color: $color-white;
  }
}

// A labeled field group inside a card.
.cms-field-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;

  label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    color: $cms-text-subtle;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
}

// Form controls (input/select/textarea) — shared base.
.cms-input,
.cms-select,
.cms-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  background: rgba(11, 12, 16, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem;
  color: $color-white;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;

  &:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: $cms-accent;
  }
}

// CMS button.
.cms-btn {
  background: $cms-accent;
  color: $cms-bg-darkest;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.65rem 1.2rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;

  &:hover {
    background: $cms-accent-hover;
    transform: translateY(-#{to-rem($space-hairline)});
  }

  &--primary {
    background: $cms-accent;
    color: $cms-bg-darkest;

    &:hover {
      background: $cms-accent-hover;
    }
  }

  &--danger {
    background: $cms-danger;
    color: $color-white;

    &:hover {
      background: $cms-danger-dark;
    }
  }

  &--secondary {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: $color-white;

    &:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    }
  }
}

// ── Notification Toast ────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
  right: to-rem($space-2xl);
  background: $cms-bg-dark;
  border: to-rem($space-hairline) solid $cms-accent;
  color: $color-white;
  padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  box-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-2xl) rgba($color-black, 0.5);
  z-index: var(--z-top);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
}

@keyframes cmsFadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-#{to-rem($space-xs)});
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

// ── CMS Editor Layout Helpers (About, Footer, Projects) ───────────────

// Card header variant.
.cms-card--header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
}

// Per-locale section card.
.cms-card--lang {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

// Editor page wrappers — block containers so each .cms-card stacks with its
// own margin; named per manager for future per-section theming.
.cms-projects-manager,
.cms-portfolio-manager,
.cms-about-manager,
.cms-footer-manager,
.cms-playground-manager,
.cms-media-converter,
.cms-deploy-info {
  display: block;
}

// Subsection header — mirrors .cms-section-header at a lower hierarchy
// level (list title + optional inline controls).
.cms-subsection-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
}

// Grouped action buttons.
.cms-btn-group {
  display: flex;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}

// Section header row (title + actions).
.cms-section-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-md);
}

// Section title.
.cms-section-title {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: $cms-accent;
  margin: 0 0 to-rem($space-sm);
  display: block;
}

// Nested subsection block.
.cms-subsection {
  margin-top: to-rem($space-md);
  padding: to-rem($space-md);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

// Subsection heading.
.cms-subsection-title {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: $cms-text-muted;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
}

// Horizontal row of fields.
.cms-field-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(to-rem(200px), 1fr));
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-md);

  > .cms-btn {
    justify-self: start;
    align-self: end;
    width: auto;
    max-width: none;
  }
}

// Aligned field-row variant.
.cms-field-row--align {
  align-items: end;
}

// Compact field group.
.cms-field-group--small {
  max-width: to-rem(160px);
}

// Field label.
.cms-label {
  color: $cms-text-muted;
  font-weight: 500;
}

// Helper/hint text under a field.
.cms-hint {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: $cms-text-subtle;
  margin-top: to-rem($space-sm);
}

// Card subtitle.
.cms-card-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: $cms-text-muted;
  margin: 0;
}

// ── Gravatar Editor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-gravatar-layout {
  display: flex;
  gap: to-rem($space-xl);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

// Gravatar preview thumbnail.
.cms-gravatar-preview {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-gravatar-img {
  width: to-rem(96px);
  height: to-rem(96px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  object-fit: cover;
  border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid $cms-accent;
}

.cms-gravatar-placeholder {
  width: to-rem(96px);
  height: to-rem(96px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  background: $cms-bg-darker;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: to-rem(40px);
  border: to-rem($space-3xs) dashed $cms-border;
}

.cms-gravatar-label {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: $cms-text-subtle;
}

.cms-gravatar-controls {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: to-rem(280px);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-preset-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
}

.cms-input--short {
  max-width: to-rem(110px);
}

// Size-preset chip — ghost variant of .cms-btn: the solid accent base would
// render the active accent ink teal-on-teal, so presets sit on the dark panel
// tone and mark selection with an accent ring + ink instead.
.cms-btn--preset {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-md);
  background: $cms-bg-dark;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
  border: to-rem($space-hairline) solid $cms-border;

  &:hover {
    background: $cms-bg-dark;
    border-color: $cms-accent;
    transform: none;
  }
}

// Selected preset — accent ring + accent ink on the dark chip (readable).
.cms-btn--active {
  border-color: $cms-accent;
  color: $cms-accent;
}

// ── Paragraph List Editor ─────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-para-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-para-item {
  display: flex;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  align-items: flex-start;

  textarea {
    flex: 1;
  }
}

.cms-para-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

// ── Channel / Link List Editor ─────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-channel-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-channel-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: to-rem(130px) 1fr auto;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  align-items: center;
}

.cms-channel-label {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-input--label {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.cms-item-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-item-label {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: $cms-accent;
}

.cms-item-controls {
  display: flex;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
}

// ── Mention Items ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-mention-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-mention-item {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

// ── Section Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-section-card {
  border-left: to-rem($space-3xs) solid $cms-accent;
}

.cms-sections-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
}

// ── Media Item ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-media-item {
  display: flex;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: to-rem($space-sm);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-media-thumb {
  width: to-rem(72px);
  height: to-rem(44px);
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid $cms-border;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-media-thumb-placeholder {
  width: to-rem(72px);
  height: to-rem(44px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: $cms-bg-darker;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
  border: to-rem($space-3xs) dashed $cms-border;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-media-fields {
  flex: 1;
}

// ── Portfolio List Editor ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Compact icon/utility buttons (reorder, delete, view links).
.cms-btn--compact {
  padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
}

// Narrower selects that shouldn't stretch to the row width.
.cms-select--narrow {
  max-width: to-rem(220px);
}

// Node selector needs room for dotted paths (pages/earth-playground etc.).
.cms-select--wide {
  max-width: to-rem(300px);
}

// Monospace dictionary editor.
.cms-json-editor {
  font-family: monospace;
  min-height: to-rem(400px);
}

// Vertical stack of portfolio item cards.
.cms-pf-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
}

// Empty-state card when the locale has no items yet.
.cms-pf-empty {
  text-align: center;
  color: $cms-text-muted;
}

// Identity row: thumb + title on the left, item controls on the right.
.cms-pf-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-md);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-pf-identity {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
}

// Cover thumbnail — same aspect as .cms-media-thumb for visual rhythm.
.cms-pf-thumb {
  width: to-rem(72px);
  height: to-rem(44px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: $cms-bg-darker;
  border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid $cms-border;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-pf-thumb-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.cms-pf-noimg {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: $cms-text-subtle;
}

.cms-pf-title {
  color: $cms-accent;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0;
}

// Field grid inside each item card.
.cms-pf-fields {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(to-rem(240px), 1fr));
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
}

// Image filename input + "view" link on one line.
.cms-pf-image-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  align-items: center;

  .cms-input {
    flex: 1;
  }
}

// Dark panel grouping the four dimension inputs.
.cms-pf-dims {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  padding: to-rem($space-sm);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  margin-top: to-rem($space-md);
}

.cms-pf-dims-title {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: $cms-text-muted;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-pf-dims-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(to-rem(160px), 1fr));
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-pf-dim-label {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

// ── Cover Layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-cover-layout {
  display: flex;
  gap: to-rem($space-lg);
  align-items: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.cms-cover-thumb {
  width: to-rem(120px);
  height: to-rem(72px);
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid $cms-border;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-cover-fields {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: to-rem(280px);
}

// ── Key/Value List Editor (Playground labels, route slugs) ────────────
.cms-kv-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-kv-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(to-rem(160px), to-rem(220px)) 1fr auto;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  align-items: center;
}

.cms-kv-key {
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: $cms-accent;
  word-break: break-all;
}

// ── Checkbox ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Bare toggle used inside kv rows (playground defaults) where a wrapping
// label would break the grid.
.cms-checkbox {
  width: to-rem($space-md);
  height: to-rem($space-md);
  accent-color: $cms-accent;
  cursor: pointer;
  justify-self: start;
}

.cms-checkbox-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  color: $cms-text-primary;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  cursor: pointer;

  input[type='checkbox'] {
    width: to-rem($space-md);
    height: to-rem($space-md);
    accent-color: $cms-accent;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
}

// ── Media Converter (localhost-only) ──────────────────────────────────
.cms-tab-badge {
  margin-left: to-rem($space-xs);
  padding: 0 to-rem($space-xs);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  background: $cms-accent;
  color: $cms-bg-card;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.cms-dropzone {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  padding: to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-lg);
  border: to-rem(2px) dashed $cms-border;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-sm);
  background: $cms-bg-card;
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    border-color 0.2s ease,
    background 0.2s ease;

  &--over {
    border-color: $cms-accent;
    background: $cms-bg-darker;
  }

  p {
    margin: 0;
    color: $cms-text-primary;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
}

.cms-dropzone-icon {
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  line-height: 1;
}

.cms-media-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
  max-height: to-rem(340px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  margin: to-rem($space-md) 0;
  padding: to-rem($space-sm);
  background: $cms-bg-card;
  border: to-rem(1px) solid $cms-border;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-xs);
}

.cms-media-list--errors {
  border-color: $cms-danger;
}

.cms-media-list-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
}

.cms-media-list-group {
  padding: to-rem($space-2xs) 0;
  border-bottom: to-rem(1px) solid $cms-border;

  &:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
}

.cms-media-list-name {
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
  word-break: break-all;
}

.cms-media-list-size {
  color: $cms-text-subtle;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.cms-media-list-out {
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: $cms-accent;
  padding-left: to-rem($space-md);
  word-break: break-all;
}

.cms-media-list-error {
  color: $cms-danger;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  text-align: right;
  word-break: break-all;
}

.cms-list-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  margin-top: to-rem($space-md);
}

.cms-progress {
  height: to-rem($space-sm);
  background: $cms-bg-card;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: to-rem($space-md) 0;
}

.cms-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: $cms-accent;
  border-radius: inherit;
  transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.cms-loader-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  margin-top: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.cms-spinner {
  width: to-rem($space-md);
  height: to-rem($space-md);
  border: to-rem(2px) solid $cms-border;
  border-top-color: $cms-accent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: cms-spin 0.9s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes cms-spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.cms-btn-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  align-items: center;
}

.cms-error-text {
  color: $cms-danger;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

// ─── Deploy Info tab ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-deploy-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin: to-rem($space-sm) 0 to-rem($space-md);
  font-size: 0.9rem;

  th,
  td {
    text-align: left;
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-sm);
    border-bottom: to-rem(1px) solid $cms-border;
  }

  th {
    color: $cms-text-subtle;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }
}

.cms-deploy-url {
  word-break: break-all;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
}

.cms-score {
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: to-rem($space-xl);
  padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-xs);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: $cms-bg-dark;
}

.cms-score--good {
  color: $cms-badge-green;
}

.cms-score--warn {
  color: $cms-badge-warn;
}

.cms-score--bad {
  color: $cms-error;
}
